description:
Reconcile membership labels that claim containment unsupported by the authoritative dependency graph so repository validation reports no membership divergences.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The repository reports zero membership divergences, with each correction grounded in its configured namespace and dependency graph.
- [hard] REQ-02: Corrected historical issues retain their states, dependency edges, descriptions, nonmembership labels, and gate status and history.
- [hard] REQ-03: Whole-repository validation passes without membership divergence warnings.
title: Reconcile stale membership labels with the dependency graph
